t: A 3D simulator for programming virtual Micromelon robots without hardware.
steps: Find the simulator in the Windows Store or the Apple App Store.
Ask IT to approve and install the app.
Contact Micromelon for a quote or start the reported trial.
Sign in to the simulator and the code editor with the same account.
Run a first block program with the virtual robot.
Read the blog post about running a term in the simulator.
